projectsSection.title: Things I've built
projectsSection.description: A few highlights from my recent work.

projects.title: Analytics Dashboard
projects.summary: A real-time dashboard that turns raw usage data into clear charts for a product team.
projects.description: Designed and built the frontend of an internal analytics tool used daily by the product team.
contribution: Built reusable chart components with React and TypeScript.
Connected the interface to a REST API with caching and error states.
Improved load time by splitting the code and lazy loading charts.

projects.title: Booking App
projects.summary: An appointment booking flow for a small clinic, usable on any device.
projects.description: Implemented the booking interface and the integration with the clinic's calendar service.
contribution: Built a multi-step booking form with validation.
Integrated the calendar API for available time slots.
